how: Fractions of the 1536 x 1024 picture, measured by 2b-seams on 2026-11-09 from zoomed crops (0.25-1% grid); the sign by flood fill of the blank face. queue: the left edge of the first person to the right edge of the last, with what they hold. heads: the top of the highest head or what it holds up. feet: the lowest foot (or where the queue goes behind furniture). eyes: the painted adults' eye line (the pictures were drawn at eye level 1.6 m, so the horizon runs through it). horizon: where the page puts the served customer's eyes: the eye line held to spec 5.2's 0.45-0.48. sign: the blank sign board's face [x0, y0, x1, y1], or null. Redraw a picture: measure it again here, then run tools/build_art.py (it copies this into BBArt.<pack>.counter).
